_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment: never edit shillinq_register.json or other fragments. ADR-041: shillinq defines BillablePeriodClosedEvent.
_meta.description: Gives CustomerMaster an externalReference: the id of this customer in another app. Any app raises BillablePeriodClosedEvent with its account id when a billable period closes (dossiq: a tenant month), and shillinq drafts the invoice for the one customer carrying that id (decision 174, REQ-UMB-005). The fragment moves CustomerMaster to 0.3.0; it sorts after the fragments that set 0.1.0 and 0.2.0, so its version wins the deep merge.

externalReference.title: External reference
externalReference.description: The id of this customer in another app, such as a dossiq tenant id. A monthly invoice that app asks for is drafted for the customer carrying its id. One customer per id.
